name: Minecraft Punishments (LiteBans)
description: Reads bans, mutes, warnings and kicks out of a LiteBans database and records them against the member who owns the account
author: Blysis

settingsCards.title: Minecraft punishments
settingsCards.description: Read a game server's LiteBans database into the punishment record.

api.description: Read the connection status, save the address and prefix, try them, or run a read now.

admin.module_minecraft-litebans_description: Reads bans, mutes, warnings and kicks out of a LiteBans database and records them against the member who owns the account

minecraftLitebans.adm_subtitle: Read a game server's LiteBans database into the punishment record on this site.
minecraftLitebans.adm_connectionDesc: LiteBans can only announce a punishment as a Discord message, which names no row and carries no dates, so its database is read directly instead. Give it a user that can only read, and only the LiteBans tables. Nothing is ever written back: the game server decides who is banned from it.
minecraftLitebans.adm_addressDialects: MySQL, MariaDB and PostgreSQL are read. LiteBans stores in H2 out of the box, and H2 cannot be read from here, so move it onto one of these in LiteBans' own config first.
minecraftLitebans.adm_addressStored: An address is stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
minecraftLitebans.adm_prefixHint: What every LiteBans table name starts with. Its default is litebans_, and a server sharing a database with something else may have changed it.
minecraftLitebans.adm_enabledHint: Checked every five minutes. Try the connection first.
minecraftLitebans.adm_readingDesc: Each kind of punishment is numbered separately by LiteBans, so each is read separately and remembers its own place.
minecraftLitebans.err_unknown_dialect: That address names a database this cannot read.
minecraftLitebans.err_bad_prefix: That is not a table prefix. Letters, digits and underscores only.
minecraftLitebans.err_litebans_unreachable: The LiteBans database did not answer.
minecraftLitebans.err_litebans_refused: The LiteBans database refused the sign-in.
minecraftLitebans.err_litebans_no_such_table: Those tables are not in that database. Check the prefix.
minecraftLitebans.err_litebans_timeout: The LiteBans database took too long to answer.
minecraftLitebans.err_litebans_failed: The LiteBans database could not be read.

admin.module_minecraft-litebans_description: Bir LiteBans veritabanındaki yasakları, susturmaları, uyarıları ve atmaları okur ve hesabın sahibi olan üyenin kaydına yazar

minecraftLitebans.adm_subtitle: Bir oyun sunucusunun LiteBans veritabanını bu sitedeki ceza kaydına okur.
minecraftLitebans.adm_connectionDesc: LiteBans bir cezayı yalnızca Discord mesajı olarak duyurabilir; o mesaj ne bir kaydı adlandırır ne de tarih taşır, bu yüzden veritabanı doğrudan okunur. Yalnızca okuyabilen ve yalnızca LiteBans tablolarına erişen bir kullanıcı ver. Geri hiçbir şey yazılmaz: kimin yasaklı olduğuna oyun sunucusu karar verir.
minecraftLitebans.adm_addressDialects: MySQL, MariaDB ve PostgreSQL okunur. LiteBans kutudan H2 ile gelir ve H2 buradan okunamaz; önce LiteBans'ın kendi ayarlarından bunlardan birine taşı.
minecraftLitebans.adm_addressStored: Kayıtlı bir adres var. Onu korumak için burayı boş bırak.
minecraftLitebans.adm_prefixHint: Her LiteBans tablo adının başındaki ek. Varsayılanı litebans_, veritabanını başka bir şeyle paylaşan bir sunucu bunu değiştirmiş olabilir.
minecraftLitebans.adm_enabledHint: Beş dakikada bir bakılır. Önce bağlantıyı dene.
minecraftLitebans.adm_readingDesc: LiteBans her ceza türünü ayrı numaralandırır, bu yüzden her biri ayrı okunur ve kendi yerini hatırlar.
minecraftLitebans.err_unknown_dialect: Bu adres okunamayan bir veritabanını gösteriyor.
minecraftLitebans.err_bad_prefix: Bu bir tablo öneki değil. Yalnızca harf, rakam ve alt çizgi.
minecraftLitebans.err_litebans_no_such_table: Bu tablolar o veritabanında yok. Öneki kontrol et.
minecraftLitebans.err_litebans_timeout: LiteBans veritabanı çok geç cevap verdi.
